audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Skill on both layers though whys[0] and early both describe Riven freely poking a slow melee; Level 6 read Skill though mid says 'you retake full control'; 2+ items read Riven though whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Zac absorbs the combo. Packet chart: Riven, Riven, Skill.
audit.why: 51.63% over 889 games, and the mirror entry (zac__riven) is already on disk — the two directions must agree on who owns each stage.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Riven, Level 6 -> Riven, 2+ items -> Skill, as three matched full/content pairs plus the Level 1 rating.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 2-3, Lvl 6, the Zac E engage window, 2+ items. Mirror point 3 confirms Blade of the Exile grants bonus AD, bonus range and one Wind Slash — now stated that way rather than as an execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] says Zac has 'no CC' at Level 1 — Stretching Strikes grabs and throws, carrying displacement. whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.you[2] all describe Wind Slash as an execute working off 'his high missing-HP tank threshold' and 'his remaining HP'. The mirror's key finding — Zac's Q reaches 800 against Riven's 275 — appears nowhere on this side.
audit.why: The 3x range gap is the whole reason this lane is a spacing problem, and the mirror entry already states it; the two directions must not disagree. Calling Wind Slash an execute invents a threshold that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Stretching Strikes: 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, 800 range, displacement, auto reset. Elastic Slingshot: 21/18/15/12/9s. Riven's longest ability reaches 275, so every point of damage taken in lane was volunteered. Wind Slash is one ranged projectile per R.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file derives a 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes' flag on Elastic Slingshot, which Riot's description does not support — it says only that he attaches his arms and launches himself forward.
audit.why: If Riven's page told players their dashes get grounded on his engage, they would hold E for a mechanic that may not exist.
audit.corrected: No grounding claim written anywhere. Flagged for human verification.

audit.why: Cell Division heals and Unstable Matter deals percent max health; the full-layer itemization already calls for early Executioner's Calling and the content layer tells you to step on blobs.

edits.before: Zac at Level 1 is just a slow melee with no CC — Q poke and auto weaves stack Runic Blade safely and stepping on his passive blobs denies his entire sustain mechanic.
edits.after: Stretching Strikes reaches 800 to your 275, but it is his only Level 1 threat — space it, stack Runic Blade off the wave, and step on every blob to deny his sustain.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile's extended range lets you punish his Elastic Slingshot landing directly, and Wind Slash executes him through his high missing-HP tank threshold before blobs fully drop.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile's extended range punishes his Elastic Slingshot landing directly, and your one Wind Slash lands before the blobs he shed can be reabsorbed for the heal.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile's extended range lets you punish his Elastic Slingshot landing — he jumps in, you R and Wind Slash the execute before he can bounce away.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile's extended range punishes his Elastic Slingshot landing — he jumps in, you R and spend your one Wind Slash before he can bounce away.

edits.before: Force the all-in at Level 6 when his Elastic Slingshot is down — he has no reliable escape tool and Wind Slash executes him through his remaining HP
edits.after: Force the all-in at Level 6 while Elastic Slingshot (9-21s) is down — with no escape tool he must eat your whole chain and your one Wind Slash

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are a respect phase: Zac will have Elastic Slingshot up and can use it defensively or to catch you if you overextend. Keep the wave near your side when you want to fight so he has to walk into your range rather than landing on you from an angle. At Level 6 you retake full control — his Elastic Slingshot is his biggest engage threat but also his biggest cooldown, and Blade of the Exile's extended range means you punish his landing zone immediately with R empowered Q plus Wind Slash execute. Force the all-in when E is down on his side, not yours.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are a respect phase: Zac will have Elastic Slingshot up and can use it defensively or to catch you if you overextend. Keep the wave near your side when you want to fight so he has to walk into your range rather than landing on you from an angle. At Level 6 you retake full control — Elastic Slingshot is his biggest engage threat but also his longest cooldown at 21 seconds rank 1, and Blade of the Exile's range means you punish his landing zone at once with R-empowered Q and your one Wind Slash. All-in while his E is down, not yours.

notes: Mirror (zac__riven) was already audited and I restated its two findings from this side rather than re-deriving them: Zac's Q reaches 800 against Riven's 275, and Blade of the Exile grants bonus AD, bonus range and one Wind Slash. Level-chart flips follow the packet so both directions agree. Packet suspectNames flagged 'Elastic Slingshot' and "Let's Bounce" — both correct names, false positives. Full-layer prose carries mojibake em dashes on disk, so full-layer edits are limited to clean-ASCII enum fields.
